---
title: "Logistic regression"
format: live-html
pyodide:
  packages:
    - micropip
---

A binary classifier: two predictors, a decision boundary, and the posterior over where that boundary
actually sits. Same [`pystanwasm`](https://github.com/habakan/pystanwasm) bridge as the other demos, via
[Quarto Live](https://r-wasm.github.io/quarto-live/).

Everything runs in a single block -- see [`linear-regression.qmd`](linear-regression.html) for why.

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
import json
import micropip
from pyodide.code import run_js

site_base = run_js(
    """
    (() => {
      const href = self.location.href;
      const quarto = href.match(/^(.*)\\/[^\\/]+_files\\/libs\\/quarto-contrib\\//);
      if (quarto) return quarto[1];
      const markers = ["/extensions/", "/assets/"];
      for (const marker of markers) {
        const idx = href.indexOf(marker);
        if (idx !== -1) return href.slice(0, idx);
      }
      return self.location.origin;
    })()
    """
)

wheel_url = site_base + "/pystanwasm-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl"
await micropip.install(wheel_url)

import numpy as np
import pystanwasm as stan

print("pystanwasm", stan.__version__)

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
N = 300
X = rng.normal(size=(N, 2))
alpha_true, beta_true = -0.5, np.array([2.0, -1.5])
p_true = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-(alpha_true + X @ beta_true)))
y = rng.binomial(1, p_true)

stan_code = """
data {
  int<lower=0> N;
  int<lower=0> K;
  matrix[N, K] X;
  array[N] int<lower=0, upper=1> y;
}
parameters {
  real alpha;
  vector[K] beta;
}
model {
  alpha ~ normal(0, 5);
  beta ~ normal(0, 5);
  y ~ bernoulli_logit(alpha + X * beta);
}
"""
data = {"N": N, "K": 2, "X": X.tolist(), "y": y.tolist()}

model = stan.StanModel(stan_code, stanwasm_path="/stanwasm/pkg/stanwasm.js")
fit = await model.sampling(data=data, iter=2000, warmup=1000, seed=42)
print("parameters:", fit.param_names)

# alpha/beta are unconstrained reals here, so unlike a <lower=0> parameter
# there's no constrained/unconstrained scale gap -- directly comparable to
# alpha_true/beta_true above.
beta_names = [n for n in fit.param_names if n.startswith("beta")]
beta_draws = np.column_stack([fit[n] for n in beta_names])
beta_mean = beta_draws.mean(axis=0)
alpha_mean = fit["alpha"].mean()
print(f"posterior mean: alpha={alpha_mean:.3f} beta={beta_mean.round(3).tolist()}")

xs = np.linspace(X[:, 0].min(), X[:, 0].max(), 50)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=y, cmap="coolwarm", alpha=0.6, edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.3)
plt.plot(xs, -(alpha_true + beta_true[0] * xs) / beta_true[1], "k--", label="true boundary")
plt.plot(xs, -(alpha_mean + beta_mean[0] * xs) / beta_mean[1], "g-", label="posterior mean")
plt.xlabel("x1")
plt.ylabel("x2")
plt.legend()
plt.title("logistic regression: recovered vs true boundary")
plt.show()
```
